#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise importer readback, scoped deletion, reapply, and DB rollback."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
IMPORTER_PATH = ROOT / "scripts" / "import_knowledge_task_manifest.py"
MANIFEST_PATH = ROOT / "db" / "manifests" / "knowledge-task-manifest.neutral.example.json"


def load_importer():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("knowledge_task_manifest", IMPORTER_PATH)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot load importer from {IMPORTER_PATH}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def main() -> None:
    module = load_importer()
    manifest = json.loads(MANIFEST_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    api = module.CourseAPI()

    # Append keeps unrelated catalog siblings intact when this scenario runs
    # after a larger multi-manifest integration batch.
    module.apply_manifest_batch([manifest], api, ownership="append")
    append_checks = module.verify_manifest_batch([manifest], api, ownership="append")
    module.apply_manifest_batch([manifest], api, ownership="append")
    repeat_checks = module.verify_manifest_batch([manifest], api, ownership="append")
    assert repeat_checks == append_checks

    partial_source = copy.deepcopy(manifest)
    lesson = partial_source["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]
    stale_task = lesson["tasks"].pop()
    selected, scope = module.scoped_manifest_batch(
        [partial_source],
        module.ScopeSelector("lesson", lesson["source_key"]),
    )
    module.apply_manifest_batch(selected, api, scope, "partial")
    partial_checks = module.verify_manifest_batch(selected, api, scope, "partial")
    assert api.request(
        "GET",
        f"/task/get/{module.source_uuid(stale_task['source_key'])}",
        allow_not_found=True,
    ) is None
    module.apply_manifest_batch(selected, api, scope, "partial")
    assert module.verify_manifest_batch(selected, api, scope, "partial") == partial_checks

    kept_task = selected[0]["modules"][0]["sections"][0]["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]
    kept_task_id = module.source_uuid(kept_task["source_key"])
    try:
        api.request(
            "POST",
            "/knowledge-import/batch",
            {
                "operations": [
                    {"method": "DELETE", "path": f"/task/delete/{kept_task_id}", "body": {}},
                    {
                        "method": "PUT",
                        "path": "/task/update/ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff",
                        "body": {},
                    },
                ]
            },
        )
    except module.ManifestError as error:
        assert "operation_index" in str(error), error
    else:
        raise AssertionError("forced batch failure unexpectedly committed")
    assert api.request("GET", f"/task/get/{kept_task_id}")["id"] == kept_task_id

    module.apply_manifest_batch([manifest], api, ownership="append")
    assert module.verify_manifest_batch([manifest], api, ownership="append") == append_checks
    print(
        "Knowledge import readback integration passed: "
        f"append={append_checks}, partial={partial_checks}, deletion/reapply/rollback verified"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
